mapper.sql: o.id, o.parent_id, o.org_type, o.name, o.path, o.depth, o.leader_id, o.sort_no, o.status, o.remark, o.created_at, o.created_by, o.updated_at, o.updated_by, o.deleted_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
AND o.status = 'active'
ORDER BY o.path ASC, o.sort_no ASC, o.id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.id IN #{item} ORDER BY o.path ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.parent_id IS NULL
AND o.status = 'active'
ORDER BY o.sort_no ASC, o.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.path LIKE CONCAT(#{pathPrefix}, '%')
AND o.status = 'active'
ORDER BY o.depth ASC, o.sort_no ASC, o.id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND (o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.status = 'active'
ORDER BY o.depth ASC, o.path ASC, o.sort_no ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.org_type = #{orgType}
AND o.id <> #{excludeId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.parent_id = #{parentId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_org o WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=sys_org, alias=o) */ AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.name = #{name} AND ((#{parentId} IS NULL AND o.parent_id IS NULL) OR o.parent_id = #{parentId})
AND o.id <> #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_org (parent_id, org_type, name, path, depth, leader_id, sort_no, status, remark, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{orgType}, #{name}, #{path}, #{depth}, #{leaderId}, IFNULL(#{sortNo}, 0), IFNULL(#{status}, 'active'), #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update:
UPDATE sys_org
name = #{name}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, remark = #{remark}, leader_id = #{leaderId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_org SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_org SET path = #{path}, depth = #{depth}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_org SET parent_id = #{parentId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_org SET leader_id = #{leaderId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
